fusions.name: Tripwire Report
fusions.desc: A shot that deals 28 damage. It only fires at a target at or below 25% of its health.

fusions.name: Scatter Burst
fusions.desc: Fires a wide cone that deals 14 damage to everything in it and stuns it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Powder Mine
fusions.desc: Conjures a charge onto the nearest enemy. It waits 25 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles takes 32 damage in a blast around it.

fusions.name: Hair Trigger
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a shot cracks to the nearest enemy within 8 tiles, dealing 8 damage. Once every 6 seconds.
